caption: Creamy yellow miso broth, slightly frothy, with noodle strands and a yellow onion slice, features golden-brown menma bamboo shoots. Served in a white ceramic bowl with blue geometric pattern and raised rim, on a black textured table with subtle grain and sheen.

segments_info.text: Black textured table surface with subtle grain pattern and slight sheen reflecting ambient light.
The miso broth is creamy yellow, smooth, and slightly frothy, with visible noodle strands and a yellow onion slice floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous texture and faint surface ridges.
White ceramic bowl with blue geometric pattern and slightly raised rim, smooth surface with faint residue along inner edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and faint yellow stain near tip.
